rows.text: You pilot your arrow-shaped ship through the stars. On a graveyard planet, you find a mountain made of Intellitron parts. The Emperor's War left behind thousands of graves, claiming both organic and inorganic lives alike.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A mangled domestic robot crawls out from the wreckage. It drags itself along with its only two remaining limbs, display screen blinking red. The apron around its waist is a sign that it once served a human family.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As the battle ends, the domestic robot flips open a cover and splashes coolant right in your face. Judging by its expression, this was probably its final, desperate strike.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Darn it, are you actually not afraid of water?" Those are the Intellitron's final words before it shuts down for good.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You snap your weapon case shut and walk away. A Galaxy Ranger never swings their blade at an opponent who can no longer fight back. The same goes for hammers and guns.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
